description:
The E-Ride Pro SS 3.0 represents the next evolution in off-road e-motos, engineered for enhanced power, precise handling, and extensive customization. This model builds upon previous generations, integrating advanced features designed for demanding off-road conditions.

Experience superior control and responsiveness with the PRO SS 3.0. Its refined design and upgraded components deliver a robust riding experience, allowing for confident navigation across varied terrains. The E-Ride Pro SS 3.0 is built to provide reliable performance for enthusiasts seeking a high-capability electric dirt bike.

ULTIMATE PEAK POWER

Superior battery power, durable motor, and outstanding controller, altogether add up to the supreme capability for a powerful off-riding journey.

ALL TERRAIN & VERSATILE

E Ride Pro is built to be ridden off road, giving riders the versatility to conquer rugged landscapes with ease, as well as mountainous conditions for adventures into the wilderness.

ZERO EMISSION ENGINEERING

The finest, lightweight, non-polluting electric motorcycle ever made. An ideal choice for modern riders who embrace the future of ecological sustainability.
